name: Pecorino Romano

low.description: About 1/3 cup grated or 1.5 oz block

siboNotes: Aged hard cheeses like Pecorino Romano are naturally low in lactose due to the aging process, making them well-tolerated for SIBO patients.
preparationTips: Grate fresh for best flavor and texture
Store wrapped in parchment paper in refrigerator
Add at the end of cooking to preserve sharp flavor
Pair with gluten-free pasta for low-FODMAP Italian dishes
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in phosphorus for bone health
Contains beneficial probiotics from aging process
